title: Staged decision fabric for safe enactment of batching & cache advice
creator: Ethan Liu
description: Build a staged decision fabric that safely enacts Optimize recommendations (batching and KV cache profiles) with operator holdpoints, traffic shadowing, small traffic slices, and automated rollback heuristics. The fabric should enable low-risk, incremental application of config changes across hosted and dedicated deployments and integrate with Console approvals and audit logs.
acceptance_criteria: Decision fabric applies a recommendation to a shadow cohort without affecting production traffic
Operator holdpoint required for >10% traffic change or latency delta >5ms
Automated rollback triggers on >2% error rate increase or >10% P95 latency regression within a 30-minute window
Every enactment is recorded in audit logs and surfaced in Console rollout timeline
Can run a dry-run that simulates cost savings and latency impact using recent telemetry
Supports model-variant fallback when a quantized/optimized variant causes regressions
design_notes: Introduce a lightweight "decision token" that checkpoints state during staged enactments to allow idempotent retries and safe rollbacks
Traffic slicing: use deterministic hash on request_id to create consistent cohorts (0.1%, 1%, 5%, 25%, 100%)
Shadowing path duplicates requests (no responses returned) to apply config in read-only mode to validate KV cache hit patterns
Operator holdpoints are surfaced as pending steps in Console with a list of observed deltas and a one-click approve/reject
Rollback heuristics tuned conservatively to prioritize availability over cost savings for the first two weeks after rollout
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Dry-run simulation using last 24h telemetry (no traffic change)
Stage 1: Shadow 0.1% of traffic for 2 hours, collect metrics
Stage 2: Progressive ramp to 1% then 5% with 30m observation windows, require operator approval to proceed beyond 5%
Stage 3: 25% ramp with automated monitoring; if stable for 6 hours, promote to 100% or schedule full apply during low-traffic window
If any threshold breaches, immediate rollback to last known-good config and operator notification
metrics: KV cache hit ratio and prefix reuse rate
Rollback frequency and mean time to rollback
test_plan: Unit tests for decision token lifecycle and idempotency
Integration tests: shadowing path against a dev model pool with synthetic traffic
Chaos test: inject latency increases and error spikes to validate rollback triggers
Canary experiment in a non-production org with real workloads for 48h
Manual operator acceptance: Console approve/reject flow exercise
